illustrations.prompt:
Create one vertical 4:5 narrative fantasy PAINTING of Geralt of Rivia, the original video-game character, not a live-action actor. This is a new peaceful scene: seated at a small wooden table inside a modest countryside inn at morning, quietly repairing the leather strap of his glove. White swept-back hair, short white beard, amber eyes, healed facial scar, familiar fitted dark leather and chainmail armor, small wolf necklace. Thoughtful tired but kind expression; believable hands carefully working on the strap. Two swords remain fully sheathed behind his shoulder, neither drawn nor used. Show him prominently from head to just below the knees, natural relaxed seated anatomy, one head, two arms, two legs. Soft daylight from a side window, calm sparse background with aged timber and a muted green view outside, no other people.
The supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their detailed Kalistar narrative painting, deliberate visible brushstrokes, sculpted painted planes, patinated materials, natural proportions, selective sharp edges on face and hands, quiet background and motivated light. No photography, no figurine, no smooth 3D, no anime/manga. No combat, threatening pose, blood, injuries or gore. No text, frame, logo, interface, statistics, or watermark. Illustration only.

Create ONE vertical 4:5 standalone narrative fantasy PAINTING for Kalistar, never an entire card. Character: Ssilas, an original adult male SERPES scout from ARBORIUM. SERPES means a humanoid snake: one clearly reptilian head with subtle compact cobra cheek hood, olive and muted bronze scales, expressive amber slit eyes, small closed mouth; no human hair, no horns. Humanoid athletic body with exactly two arms, two legs and normal grounded boots; no snake tail replacing legs and no extra limbs. Mature elegant rather than frightening.
Story moment: paused halfway across a thick moss-covered fallen tree over a shallow woodland stream. His bent knees and balanced feet make the footing convincing. His right hand holds a beautifully crafted recurved wooden bow, coherent bowstring and shape, lowered beside his body and clearly visible; a quiver on his back. His left fingertips gently inspect a freshly bent fern near the trunk, following the trail of lost travellers. His attentive compassionate expression tells of a vigilant guide, not a generic combat pose. Three-quarter face looking toward the fern, prominent central face and gesture. Weathered dark green cloak, charcoal leather trousers, muted plum sash, small restrained bronze clasps, tactile materials. Keep limbs and hands anatomically clear.
Arborium is a living woodland of towering old trees, roots, ferns and dappled daylight. Calm coherent background: only a few large trunks, spacious bright woodland beyond, one shallow stream with believable reflections. No dense clutter, no medieval city, no oversized magical spectacle.
Match the TWO supplied images as STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: detailed Kalistar narrative fantasy painting, visible deliberate brushstrokes and broken painted color planes, selective sharp edges, naturally expressive painted face, patinated cloth/wood/metal, motivated dappled light, warm face highlights against cooler forest shadow. This is painterly and humanly emotional, NOT photography, NOT glossy 3D, NOT anime or manga. Character occupies most of the vertical canvas, readable in a card art window 737 by 921; face and main gesture in central region, clear bow silhouette. No text, lettering, frame, logo, UI, stats, watermark, combat or blood.
